# IPv4 e instradamento statico; le interfacce Kathara sono già attive.
ip -4 address show dev eth0 | grep -Fq 'inet 10.15.2.13/24 ' || ip address add 10.15.2.13/24 dev eth0

ip route replace default via 10.15.2.1 dev eth0

# Cache ARP statica per soli vicini dello stesso dominio L2 (riduce ICMP iniziali).
ip -4 neigh replace 10.15.2.1 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:02:01 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.15.2.11 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:02:02 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.15.2.12 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:02:03 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.15.2.14 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:02:05 nud permanent dev eth0

# Gateway ICMP warmup; bounded, not fatal if router is late. 
probe_attempt=0
while [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ]; do
  if ping -n -I eth0 -c 1 -W 1 10.15.2.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  probe_attempt=$((probe_attempt + 1))
  [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ] || break
  sleep 1
done
